$comment: Named maritime / air / land chokepoints with geo coords. Used by overlap engine for chokepoint-axis clusters and by Leaflet map markers.

chokepoints.name: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoints.throughput_note: ~17 Mb/d crude + condensate (2026 baseline); ~20% global LNG

chokepoints.name: Bab el-Mandeb
chokepoints.throughput_note: ~6 Mb/d oil pre-Houthi attacks; ~10% global maritime trade

chokepoints.name: Suez Canal
chokepoints.throughput_note: ~12% global trade by tonnage; ~30% global container traffic pre-2024

chokepoints.name: Malacca Strait
chokepoints.throughput_note: ~30% global trade; ~80% NE Asia crude imports

chokepoints.name: Taiwan Strait
chokepoints.throughput_note: ~40% of global container traffic transits; semiconductor exposure

chokepoints.name: Bosphorus / Turkish Straits
chokepoints.throughput_note: Black Sea grain corridor; Russian Black Sea fleet

chokepoints.name: Port of Houston
chokepoints.throughput_note: US Gulf petchem + LNG export hub

chokepoints.name: Port of New Orleans / Lower Mississippi
Port of Rotterdam
chokepoints.throughput_note: Largest EU port; ARA refining hub; Rhine entry

chokepoints.name: Port of Antwerp-Bruges
chokepoints.throughput_note: EU chemicals cluster; second largest EU port

chokepoints.name: Rhine inland waterway
chokepoints.throughput_note: Drought-sensitive low-water draft restrictions; chem + steel logistics

chokepoints.name: Ports of Los Angeles / Long Beach
chokepoints.throughput_note: Largest US container gateway (~31% of US containerised imports); ILWU labour exposure
